configUsed._sources_note: Source types and capacities below are built from WASAC's own published treatment-plant registry (wasac.rw/en/about/water-treatment-plants) plus reporting confirming Nzove/Kanzenze/Gihira draw from rivers (Nyabarongo, Nyabarongo, Sebeya respectively) that visibly drop in dry season. Districts absent from districtCapacity_m3 have no centrally-tracked plant (likely rural/borehole schemes) and are left uncapped until better data is found.
configUsed._districtCapacity_m3_note: Built from WASAC's published per-plant capacities, summed by hosting district. Nzove + Kimisagara (both physically in Nyarugenge, serve all of Kigali) and Karenge's Kigali-bound 80% share are pooled (115,000 m3/day total) and split across Gasabo/Kicukiro/Nyarugenge by population share (210k/190k/318k). Karenge's remaining 20% (3,000) plus Muhazi (5,400) stay with Rwamagana. Districts not listed here have no known centrally-tracked plant and are left uncapped (unlimited) — verify before trusting those numbers in a real report.
